purpose: Step-by-step visual description of how the application thinks, processes, and creates outcomes at each phase. Designed for visual rendering and stakeholder communication.

overview.tagline: Detect the gap between what companies SAY and what EVIDENCE shows they actually ARE
overview.core_formula: Reality Gap = Intent Score - Reality Score
ai_models_used: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Extended Thinking + Brave Web Search) — Primary reality scanner
Claude Opus 4.6 (Extended Thinking, 10K budget) — Primary synthesis engine
Gemini 3.1 Pro (Google Search grounding) — Fact-checker + fallback
Rule-based keyword engine — Intent analysis (no AI model)

flow.name: Knowledge Base Foundation
flow.short_description: The shared vocabulary that grounds ALL analysis
flow.what_happens: Before any scan runs, the system maintains a centralized Knowledge Base (KB) that defines the vocabulary, dimensions, archetypes, and anti-patterns. This ensures every AI model and every phase speaks the same language.

five_dimensions.name: Operating Model
five_dimensions.what_it_measures: How the company organizes work and decision-making

five_dimensions.name: Strategy
five_dimensions.what_it_measures: How the company plans and adapts to change

five_dimensions.name: Culture & Values
five_dimensions.what_it_measures: The human side — can people thrive and innovate?

five_dimensions.name: Service Portfolio
five_dimensions.what_it_measures: What they sell and how modern their offerings are

five_dimensions.name: AI Readiness
five_dimensions.what_it_measures: Technical maturity and readiness for AI-driven transformation

Modernizing.meaning: Strong ops but financial pressure — investing in transformation

Cash Cow.meaning: Profitable but operationally outdated — living on legacy advantages

At Risk.meaning: Both operations and finances under pressure — unsustainable

flow.ai_model_used: None — curated human expertise encoded as structured data

flow.name: Foresight Knowledge Base Harvesting
flow.short_description: Autonomous AI agent harvests megatrend signals from 30 futures themes
flow.what_happens: An autonomous AI agent searches the web for megatrend signals across 30 strategic foresight (FP) themes. Each theme is mapped to Knowledge Base dimensions. The agent harvests signals, classifies their force type, timeframe, and confidence, then stores them for later use during company scans.

thinking_process.detail: System iterates through 30 pre-defined Futures Platform (FP) themes covering technology, society, economy, environment, and governance
For each theme, AI performs live web searches to find recent signals, reports, and evidence of emerging trends
Each signal is classified by: force_type (Probable/Emerging, Plausible/Maturing, Weakening/Declining, Preposterous/Black Swan), timeframe (6-12mo, 12-24mo, 24-36mo), and confidence (high/medium/low)
Each signal is mapped to one or more of the 5 Knowledge Base dimensions so it can later be applied to company-specific analysis
URLs are verified via HTTP. Source credibility is assessed (high/medium/low). Only verified signals are stored.
Harvested signals are stored in the Foresight Knowledge Base for use during company scans. ~15-20 minutes for full harvest.

flow.ai_model_used: Gemini 3.1 Pro with Google Search grounding
flow.agentic_pattern: Autonomous harvest agent — iterates 30 themes, searches web, classifies signals, verifies sources, stores results. Runs ~15-20 minutes unattended.

flow.name: Scan Initiation & Data Collection
flow.short_description: User provides company name + optional sources; system auto-discovers URL
flow.what_happens: The scan begins when a user enters a company name. The system auto-discovers the company URL if not provided. Users can optionally upload internal documents (PDF/HTML, max 3 files, 10MB each) and paste additional narrative text. The system also supports URL-based auto-scraping.

inputs.name: Company Name
inputs.how_used: Primary identifier for all searches and storage

inputs.name: Company URL
inputs.how_used: Enables website scraping for narrative text; AI auto-discovers if left blank

inputs.name: Internal Documents
inputs.how_used: Extracted text feeds into Intent Analysis for deep-dive scoring

inputs.name: Narrative Text
inputs.example: Annual report text, strategy documents, 'About Us' content
inputs.how_used: Direct text input for Intent Analysis keyword scanning

auto_discovery.description: When user enters company name and leaves URL blank, system calls /api/find-url to auto-discover the company website

flow.ai_model_used: None for input collection (AI used for URL auto-discovery)

flow.name: Scanner 1: Intent Analysis
flow.short_description: Rule-based keyword engine measures narrative ambition across 5 dimensions
flow.what_happens: The system scans ALL collected text (website content, uploaded documents, pasted text) for positive and negative keywords defined in the Knowledge Base. This produces the Intent Score — a measure of how ambitious the company's narrative is.
flow.question_it_answers: How ambitious is this company's narrative compared to typical companies?

thinking_process.detail: Combine website scraped text + uploaded document text + user-pasted text into single corpus

For each of the 5 KB dimensions, scan text for positive keywords (e.g., 'Autonomy', 'Platform', 'SaaS') and negative keywords (e.g., 'Silos', 'Legacy', 'Waterfall'). Each dimension has 25 positive and 25 negative keywords.
Phrases like 'we avoid waterfall' or 'moving away from silos' are NOT counted as negative signals. Prevents false positives.
Regex word-boundary matching prevents partial-word false hits (e.g., 'platform' in 'platforming' context)
Good keywords require >= 3 mentions to count as a signal. Bad keywords require >= 1 mention. This prevents noise from single casual mentions.
Per dimension: net_result = unique_good_found - unique_bad_found. Category score = (net_result / 25) * 100, capped at 100.
Average of all dimension scores. Also calculates Friction Index (contradictory signals) and Vibrancy Score (keyword density).
Short documents are not penalized; long documents are not inflated. Prevents length bias.

flow.why_no_ai: Keyword matching is deterministic, fast, and reproducible. AI would add latency and non-determinism without improving accuracy for this specific task.

outputs.per_dimension_breakdown: Individual scores per dimension with matched keyword counts
outputs.friction_index: 0-1, degree of contradictory messaging (high = mixed signals)

accuracy_safeguards: Word boundary checks prevent partial matches
Threshold counting prevents noise from single mentions
Text length normalization prevents size bias
High friction index flags contradictory messaging for human review

flow.name: Scanner 2: Reality Check (5-Jury Agentic Model)
flow.short_description: Five autonomous AI jury-agents independently hunt for real-world evidence
flow.what_happens: This is the core agentic AI phase. Five independent AI 'jury' agents each search the live web for evidence in their specialist area. They operate autonomously, making search decisions, evaluating evidence quality, and scoring independently. The system then aggregates their findings.
flow.question_it_answers: What does independent external evidence ACTUALLY show about this company's operational maturity?

thinking_process.detail: Five specialist jury-agents are launched, each with their own search strategy and evaluation criteria. They operate independently and do not see each other's results.

jury_1_architecture.name: Architecture & Engineering Jury
jury_1_architecture.searches_for: GitHub repos, engineering blogs, tech stacks, job postings, DevOps evidence
jury_1_architecture.determines: Modern vs legacy architecture. Platform engineering adoption. Technical debt indicators.

jury_2_strategy.name: Strategy & Finance Jury
jury_2_strategy.searches_for: Annual reports, financial databases, investment signals, M&A activity
jury_2_strategy.determines: Are they investing in digital transformation? Is strategy adaptive or static?

jury_3_culture.name: Culture & Talent Jury
jury_3_culture.searches_for: Glassdoor reviews, LinkedIn hiring patterns, meetup sponsorships, employer branding
jury_3_culture.determines: Can they retain talent? Is psychological safety real or performative?

jury_4_ai_data.name: AI & Data Maturity Jury
jury_4_ai_data.searches_for: Hugging Face models, cloud case studies, academic papers, AI product launches
jury_4_ai_data.determines: Real ML adoption or pilot purgatory? Data platform maturity.

jury_5_service_portfolio.name: Service & Product Jury
jury_5_service_portfolio.searches_for: Service pages, case studies, analyst reports, product launches, partnership ecosystem
jury_5_service_portfolio.determines: Can they deliver modern services? Platform vs project-based?

thinking_process.detail: Starting from a neutral base of 50, each jury adjusts the score based on evidence found. Recent evidence (<12 months) has 100% impact. Old evidence (>18 months) has only 20% impact. Technical debt evidence incurs -20 to -35 penalty. Near-zero evidence across all juries incurs -35 to -50 penalty.

scoring_rules.near_zero_evidence_penalty: -35 to -50 if almost no evidence found

thinking_process.detail: If initial confidence < 45 OR evidence links < 3, the system autonomously identifies which juries are weak, builds broader search terms, re-searches, and merges new findings. This is a self-directed research loop.
thinking_process.agentic_behavior: The system decides ON ITS OWN whether to do more research, what to search for, and when to stop.

loop_rules.stop_condition: Confidence >= 45 or no new evidence found

thinking_process.detail: Every evidence URL is verified via HTTP request. Dead links are detected and counted.
If the score changed >= 15 points from the previous scan, the ENTIRE search is re-run autonomously to verify the change is real.
thinking_process.agentic_behavior: System autonomously decides to re-run based on score delta, without human intervention.

outcome_rules.both_runs_agree: Accept as genuine change, average the two scores

thinking_process.detail: Previous findings carry forward for 90 days. The principle is 'Innocent until proven fixed' — not re-finding something is treated as search noise, not improvement.
thinking_process.rationale: Search engines return different results each time. A company doesn't fix its problems just because Google showed different results today.

thinking_process.detail: Cross-references Intent Score with Reality Score. If Intent > 60 AND Reality is significantly below, flags potential washing.
washing_types: AI Washing: AI buzzwords without real adoption evidence
Agile Washing: Claims modern practices, evidence shows waterfall
Green Washing: ESG narrative without sustainable operations evidence
Modernization Washing: 'Digital transformation' messaging with no operational evidence
safety_checks: Cannot flag washing if Intent < 40 (low ambition can't be washing)
Re-checked after synthesis: if Reality >= Intent, washing flag removed

flow.ai_model_used: Claude Sonnet 4.6 with Extended Thinking + Brave Web Search (primary, 10 searches per jury). Gemini 3.1 Pro with Google Search grounding (fallback + fact-check).

outputs.jury_findings: Per-jury evidence with sentiment, recency, source type
outputs.evidence_links: Verified URLs with titles, snippets, source domains
outputs.key_people: Executives discovered in evidence (name, role, relevance)
outputs.confidence_score: 0-100, how robust the evidence base is

flow.name: Financial Health Index
flow.short_description: AI-powered financial analysis running in parallel with Reality Check
flow.what_happens: While Scanner 2 hunts for operational evidence, a parallel AI agent searches for financial data. It evaluates four dimensions of business health and produces the Financial Health Index used for archetype classification.
flow.question_it_answers: How financially healthy is this company?

four_dimensions.name: Revenue Trend
four_dimensions.measures: Declining, stable, or growing revenue trajectory

four_dimensions.name: Profitability
four_dimensions.measures: Operating margins, net profit, EBITDA trends

four_dimensions.name: Investment Signal
four_dimensions.measures: R&D spending, growth investment, M&A activity

core_health_gate.description: If BOTH Revenue and Profitability are weak, the composite score is dampened regardless of Efficiency/Investment scores
core_health_gate.floor: 25% of weighted base when fundamentals are weak
core_health_gate.fully_open: When Revenue + Profitability reach 60% of maximum
core_health_gate.rationale: A company that invests heavily but doesn't generate revenue is not financially healthy

flow.ai_model_used: Claude Sonnet 4.6 with Extended Thinking + Brave Web Search
flow.agentic_pattern: Autonomous financial evidence search with structured scoring
flow.non_blocking: If financial search fails, the scan continues with Financial Index = null. Intent Score is used as proxy for archetype classification.

outputs.sub_scores: Revenue Trend (0-25), Profitability (0-25), Efficiency (0-25), Investment Signal (0-25)
outputs.financial_findings: Per-dimension evidence with quotes and sources
outputs.revenue_avg_3yr: 3-year average revenue in EUR millions (determines company size tier: S/M/L/XL)

flow.name: Self-Analysis Loop
flow.short_description: AI diagnoses WHY its own scores changed — search variance, gaps, or real change?
flow.what_happens: When scores change significantly between scans, the system performs autonomous self-diagnosis. It computes pre-computed diagnostics and uses AI to classify the root cause of score drift. This prevents false confidence in changed scores.
flow.question_it_answers: Why did the scanner produce different results this time? Is it noise or genuine change?
flow.trigger: Score changed >= 15 points within 7 days of previous scan

thinking_process.detail: Automatically computed: source diversity (unique domains), jury coverage, evidence recency ratio, URL overlap between scans (low overlap <20% = strong search variance indicator)
AI classifies the drift into one of 4 causes
causes: Search Variance: Different Google results each time (most common, ~60% of cases)
Evidence Gap: One scan found sources the other missed
Prompt Sensitivity: Same evidence, AI interpreted differently
Genuine Change: Real company change (unlikely within 7 days)

thinking_process.detail: Maximum drift of 15 points per 7-day window. Larger changes are dampened to previous ± 15 max. Protects against volatile AI search results.

flow.ai_model_used: Uses the diagnostics computed from the scan data + AI classification
flow.agentic_pattern: Self-reflective agent that monitors its own output quality and automatically applies corrections

flow.name: Synthesis & Cross-Verification (Wisdom Layer)
flow.short_description: Senior AI model reads ALL evidence blindly, scores independently, then cross-verifies against Scanner scores
flow.what_happens: This is the 'wisdom layer'. A senior AI model (Claude Opus 4.6) reads ALL collected evidence WITHOUT seeing any Scanner scores. It independently evaluates Reality and Intent. Its blind scores are then compared to Scanner scores, and disagreements are resolved through a blending protocol.
flow.question_it_answers: Do independent AI eyes validate the automated scanners? What is the diagnosis and strategic pitch?

thinking_process.detail: Senior AI model receives ALL evidence (jury findings, URLs, key people, financial data) but ZERO Scanner scores. It independently scores each KB dimension 0-20, totaling 0-100 for Reality. Also independently assesses Intent.
thinking_process.why_blind: Prevents anchoring bias. If the model saw Scanner scores first, it would unconsciously validate them rather than truly verify.

thinking_process.detail: Compare blind Synthesis scores vs Scanner scores and resolve disagreements

resolution_rules.delta_0_to_5: Agreement — keep Scanner score (search-grounded, more reliable for small variations)
resolution_rules.delta_6_to_10: Mild disagreement — blended average: 60% Scanner + 40% Synthesis
resolution_rules.delta_over_10: Strong disagreement — Synthesis overrides (broader context, extended thinking)

thinking_process.detail: Using verified scores and all evidence, the model generates two key outputs

outputs.diagnosis: 180-220 words. States archetype, maps findings to KB dimensions, uses KB terminology. Written for C-level audience.
outputs.strategic_pitch: 90-110 words. C-level cold-outreach with exactly 2 concrete proposals derived from the weakest KB dimensions.

thinking_process.detail: AI generates 2 Desired Impact (WHY) proposals and 2 Desired Effect (WHAT) proposals based on the weakest KB dimensions. These are actionable conversation starters for consultants.
thinking_process.constraint: Proposals MUST be grounded in the company's actual weaknesses, not generic advice

flow.ai_model_used: Claude Opus 4.6 with Extended Thinking (primary, 10K thinking budget)
flow.why_fallback_chain: During high API load, any single provider may be unavailable. The 4-model chain ensures synthesis ALWAYS completes.
flow.agentic_pattern: Blind cross-verification agent with autonomous fallback chain. Extended Thinking allows the model to reason through conflicting evidence before committing to scores.

flow.name: Fact-Check & Evidence Integrity Gate
flow.short_description: Independent AI with live web search verifies every claim against reality
flow.what_happens: An independent AI model (Gemini 3.1 Pro with Google Search) reads the generated summary and pitch, then independently verifies every factual claim using live web search. This catches EVIDENCE CONTAMINATION — the real problem is not hallucination but wrong evidence feeding correct-looking summaries.
flow.question_it_answers: Are the claims in the AI-generated summary actually TRUE?
flow.core_insight: Checking AI output against its own evidence is CIRCULAR. The evidence itself may be wrong. An independent model with live web search must verify against the REAL WORLD.

thinking_process.detail: Rule-based checks: Does summary reference people not in evidence? Claims with no supporting links? Generic template language? Low confidence but certain tone? Produces risk score (0-100) — diagnostic only, does not block pipeline.

Gemini 3.1 Pro with Google Search grounding receives the full summary, pitch, evidence links, and company name. It uses Google Search to independently verify each factual claim. Classifies each claim as verified (true) or false.
thinking_process.single_pass_guarantee: Runs EXACTLY once. No recursive loops. Fixes what it finds in a single pass.

thinking_process.detail: No false claims found. Original synthesis stands. Continue to Archetype Classification.

thinking_process.action: If False Claims Found — Evidence Purging + Correction
thinking_process.detail: False claims trigger a 4-step correction
sub_steps: A. Evidence Purging: Remove contaminated sources that supported false claims
B. Apply Corrected Summary: Use the corrected text produced by the fact-checker (inline correction — preferred)
C. Fallback Re-synthesis: If inline correction unavailable, trigger full re-synthesis with cleaned evidence, explicitly listing false claims to avoid
D. Clear Stale Flags: Remove washing flags that were based on now-purged false claims

flow.ai_model_used: Gemini 3.1 Pro with Google Search grounding
flow.agentic_pattern: Independent fact-checking agent with live web access. Acts as a quality gate that can autonomously purge evidence and correct outputs.

outputs.verified: Boolean — did the summary pass fact-check?
outputs.false_claims: List of specific false claims detected
outputs.evidence_purged: Count and details of removed contaminated sources

flow.name: Strategic Foresight Application
flow.short_description: Foresight KB signals are applied to the specific company context
flow.what_happens: The harvested megatrend signals from the Foresight KB (Phase 1) are now applied to this specific company. The system identifies which forces are most relevant to the company's KB dimension weaknesses and strengths, generates dimension-specific forces, a cross-impact chain, and micro-scenarios.
flow.question_it_answers: What external forces will impact THIS company's future, given its specific strengths and weaknesses?

thinking_process.detail: Match harvested foresight signals to the company's KB dimension scores. Prioritize forces that impact the company's weakest dimensions.
For each relevant force: describe the trend, its impact on this specific company, timeframe, force type, confidence level, and source verification status.
Generate a causal chain showing how forces cascade: e.g., 'AI automation pressure -> impacts Operating Model -> which cascades to Service Portfolio -> ultimately affecting Financial Health'
Generate 3 micro-scenarios: Acceleration (best case), Stagnation (status quo), Disruption (worst case). Each grounded in the specific forces identified.
All foresight sources are independently verified. Quality assessment (high/medium/low). Insufficient evidence is flagged with warning.
Generate a forward-looking narrative summary integrating the forces, chain, and scenarios into a coherent strategic outlook.

flow.ai_model_used: Claude Sonnet 4.6 with Extended Thinking (for company-specific application)
flow.agentic_pattern: Foresight application agent that autonomously matches signals to company context and generates strategic outlook

outputs.dimension_forces: Array of force cards with trend, impact, timeframe, confidence, sources
outputs.cross_impact_chain: Causal chain string (A -> B -> C -> D)
outputs.foresight_links: Validated source links with credibility ratings
outputs.validation_summary: Quality assessment of the foresight evidence base

flow.name: Archetype Classification & Storage
flow.short_description: Final classification, persistence, and dashboard display
flow.what_happens: All verified scores are used to classify the company into one of four archetypes (Thriving, Modernizing, Cash Cow, At Risk). The complete result — scores, evidence, summary, pitch, proposals, foresight — is persisted to storage and appears on the dashboard's Truth Matrix scatter plot.

thinking_process.detail: Apply the 2x2 matrix: Reality Score (Y-axis) vs Financial Index (X-axis). If Financial unavailable, Intent Score used as proxy.
Final consistency checks: washing impossible if Reality >= Intent. Archetype recalculated from final verified scores. Confidence score reflects evidence robustness.
Full result stored to Vercel Blob Storage. Dashboard index updated. Scan history maintained (rolling 12-scan window for trend analysis).
Company appears on the Truth Matrix scatter plot. Dot color = archetype. Dot size = revenue tier (S/M/L/XL). Reference companies (Tesla, Buurtzorg, Supercell, etc.) shown with pulsing green dots.

outputs.archetype: One of: Thriving, Modernizing, Cash Cow, At Risk
outputs.complete_report: All scores, evidence, summary, pitch, proposals, foresight, stored as JSON
outputs.dashboard_entry: Summary row in the Forensic Index table
outputs.truth_matrix_dot: Positioned on X (Financial) / Y (Reality) scatter plot

batch_refresh.description: Server-side autonomous batch that re-scans ALL companies in the database
batch_refresh.agentic_behavior: Runs unattended on the server — admin can close browser. Progress tracked via polling.
batch_refresh.ai_model_used: Same pipeline as single scan, applied to each company sequentially

reality_check_all.description: Re-verify all stored company summaries against live web data
reality_check_all.ai_model_used: Gemini 3.1 Pro with Google Search grounding
reality_check_all.auto_cleaning: Automatically purges false claims and corrects summaries

stakeholder_enrichment.description: Enrich key people data with LinkedIn insights — career moves, topics, notable posts
stakeholder_enrichment.ai_model_used: AI with web search for LinkedIn intelligence gathering

proposal_refresh.description: Regenerate WHY/WHAT proposals for companies using latest evidence
proposal_refresh.ai_model_used: Same synthesis model chain (Opus -> Gemini fallbacks)

statistical_analysis.description: Cross-company statistical intelligence — correlations, distributions, rankings
analyses: Spearman rank correlation (primary — robust to non-normal data)
statistical_analysis.ai_model_used: Server-side statistical computation (no AI model — pure math)

longitudinal_trend_analysis.description: Track how companies evolve across multiple scans over time
longitudinal_trend_analysis.lookback: Up to 3 previous scans (rolling 12-scan history window)
longitudinal_trend_analysis.persistent_pattern_detection: 2+ scans = high confidence pattern. 1 scan = possible search variance.

verification_layers.summary: Seven layers of accuracy assurance operate across the entire pipeline

layers.name: Jury Diversity
layers.description: Five independent evidence hunts. Confidence requires 3+ juries with evidence.

layers.name: Evidence Validation
layers.description: Every URL verified via HTTP. Dead links trigger recovery. Remaining dead links penalize confidence.

layers.name: Blind Cross-Verification
layers.description: Synthesis model scores independently without seeing Scanner scores. Disagreements trigger blending or override.

layers.name: AI Fact-Check
layers.description: Independent Gemini model with live Google Search verifies every claim. False claims trigger evidence purging. Single-pass guarantee.
layers.prevents: Evidence contamination, circular validation, hallucinated facts

layers.name: Score Drift Guard
layers.description: Max ±15 points per 7-day window. Large changes trigger self-analysis diagnostic.
layers.prevents: Volatile scores from search engine randomness

layers.name: Evidence Persistence
layers.description: Previous findings carry forward for 90 days. Not re-finding ≠ improvement.
layers.prevents: False improvements from lucky search results

layers.name: Logic Consistency
layers.description: Post-verification: washing impossible if Reality >= Intent. Archetype recalculated from final scores.
